verdict.line: You lose if you let Disdain catch you and eat the point-blank Purge that follows; you win if you poke from max range, blind every Purge channel, and let mushrooms do the zoning he can't dash through safely.

brief.thesis: Urgot's Corrosive Charge (Q, 800 range) outranges your Blinding Dart (680 range), so he dictates poke exchanges, and his Disdain (E, 475 range) is the only way he closes that gap — once it lands he follows with Purge for a real burst window, which is exactly why OP.GG's own numbers show Urgot holding the lane and solo-kill edge. Your actual counter isn't out-ranging him, it's denying the Purge: Blinding Dart during his channel and using Noxious Traps to make the ground around you expensive to dash into.

theirWindow.when: After he lands Disdain on you
theirWindow.what: He'll immediately follow with Purge at point-blank range for a big burst combo. Blind him with Blinding Dart the instant you're caught — this blocks the Purge autos — and lean on Move Quick's passive speed to peel away before he can reset.

yourWindow.when: While his E (Disdain) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Corrosive Charge is his only remaining poke tool (10/9.5/9/8.5/8s cooldown). Sit at max range, land Blinding Dart, stack a few Toxic Shot ticks, and disengage before Disdain is back up.

start.why: Most-played start into this matchup (70% pick, 50.6% WR over 745 games) — the extra sustain and mana offset how often you're kiting and throwing Blinding Dart at max range instead of trading autos.

boots.why: Higher win rate than Sorcerer's Shoes in this matchup (48.7% vs 46.9%) — the flat move speed matters more than magic pen when your entire plan is staying outside Disdain's 475 range.

core.why: Best-performing opening item (54.8% WR path, 252 games) — the proc damage and wave clear let you poke and reset without committing to extended trades.
Burn damage punishes Urgot for standing in Purge range of you — the longer he channels to catch stacks, the more he bleeds.
Caps the highest-WR build path — pushes your trap and poke damage up for the mid-to-late lane phase where the matchup is closest to even.

situational.when: you're already ahead on poke and want to snowball burst on a low-health Urgot
the game is dragging into stalemate skirmishes and you need the extra utility stats
you're stacking Toxic Shot ticks reliably and want the attack speed to apply more of them per trade

runes.keystoneWhy: Highest-performing page in this matchup (54.4% WR) — the stacking damage amp rewards landing multiple Toxic Shot autos before Urgot can disengage or Purge you down.

summoners.why: By far the dominant pick in this matchup (90.5% pick rate, 48.1% WR) — Ignite punishes the poison-DoT style of trade this lane produces, and Flash is your only way to dodge a committed Disdain if you misjudge its 475 range.

playing.title: Respect the 800-range Corrosive Charge
playing.detail: Don't stand in minion-free space inside Urgot's Q range — it outranges your Blinding Dart by 120 units, so he gets a free poke window every time you're caught without wave cover.

playing.title: Blind every Purge he commits to
playing.detail: The moment Disdain lands on you, Blinding Dart him immediately — this is the tool that blocks the Purge autos that follow, not something to save for poke.

playing.title: Lay mushrooms on his dash lane
playing.detail: Noxious Trap has only a 1s cooldown and 230 range, so drop several along the path Disdain would take to reach you — he either eats the slow and damage or reroutes and loses tempo.

playing.title: Never let Move Quick get interrupted for free
playing.detail: Your passive move speed buff only breaks when an enemy champion or turret hits you, so refuse to walk into Corrosive Charge or Purge range just to land one more auto.

playing.title: Stack poison before you commit to a trade
playing.detail: Toxic Shot has no cooldown and applies on every auto, so get two or three ticks on him from max range before extending — you win extended exchanges on damage over time, not head-on burst.

playing.title: Track his E cooldown to time your pokes
playing.detail: Disdain sits at 16-14s cooldown depending on rank — once it's down, Corrosive Charge is his only threat, so this is your window to walk up and farm Blinding Dart cooldowns onto him.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, rune, boots, and summoner recommendations are pulled directly from measured OP.GG win rates on the current patch (16.19.1); the cooldown numbers, ability interactions, and tactical reasoning about when and how to trade are my own analysis built on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of Urgot closing in with Disdain (E). Be careful of his Purge (W) when he closes in! Use Blinding Dart [Q] to block the damage on Purge (W)!
